jobs.prompt:
chore: remove the TypeScript and Rust gateways from the C++ gateway branch

CONTEXT (you have no other context than this prompt and the repository)
You start from branch `agent-jobs/cppgw-integrate-f2-20261118-44374217576-1` of ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi: the integrated native C++ gateway (`cpp/gateway/`, 450 test binaries green on Linux ARM64), still sitting next to the original TypeScript gateway (`src/`, `serve.ts`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `tools/`, `lib/`, `types/`) and a separate Rust workspace (`rust/`). OWNER DECISION: this branch is cleaned up to contain the C++ gateway and what it needs; the TypeScript and Rust versions are removed here and stay available on other branches for reference. Production keeps running from another branch, and the C++ branch is merged to main only once it is stable, so nothing you delete here affects the running service. Your branch becomes a pull request stacked on the integration pull request; your final message is its body: a short plain-language summary for the owner (what was removed, what was kept and why, counts before and after, what was verified, what is left).

An inventory was already done, by building and testing a reduced tree: fetch `agent-jobs/cppgw-cleanup-inventory-20261118-44382623369-1` and merge it first (it only adds `cpp/gateway/docs/CLEANUP-PLAN.md` and `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/cppgw-cleanup-inventory-20261118.md`). READ BOTH FULLY before deleting anything: the plan lists, for every top-level entry, KEEP / MOVE / REMOVE, the files that must be moved into `cpp/gateway` first (the confinement C source and two V8 codec files from `src/`, `scripts/build-native-kv.ts` and `openai-spec-pin.json`, `tools/native-kv/`, one fixture from `tests/`, one research note from `docs/`), the root files to rewrite (`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.gitignore`, `.githooks/pre-commit`, `.prettierrc`, `.prettierignore`, a format-only `package.json` and `bun.lock`), and how the paired Bun conformance oracle keeps working from the pinned legacy commit `2b23fb6837e2b5c0dc9ffa50771f52d322dd413a` (an ancestor of your branch) through a `git worktree`/fetch-by-commit.

GENERAL RULES
- The runner holds a model gateway token: never print it or write any credential to a file. Run tests with an empty `HOME`, a fresh `TMPDIR` and no provider variables. No real provider traffic: use local mocks only.
- This task DOES remove the TypeScript and Rust trees and edits root files and `.github/workflows` as described below. Do not delete or weaken C++ tests.
- Model connections can drop: create your report file in the first minutes and commit small steps often (the tree must build at each commit). Leave no build output, binaries or downloads in the checkout.
- Report file: `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/<job id>.md`: what you did, exact commands, real counts and measurements, what is unfinished, defects found outside your paths (report, do not fix). End your final message with the same summary.

YOUR MACHINE: GitHub-hosted Linux ARM64 runner (Ubuntu 24.04, 4 CPUs, 16 GB, sudo, network). Its packages are too old for this tree: install Clang 21 or newer from apt.llvm.org (or GCC 14+), build Boost 1.92.0 `json` and `container` static libraries from the official source archive in a temp directory (the tree needs Boost >= 1.86), install OpenSSL 3, zlib, ICU, brotli, zstd development packages and build SQLite 3.54.0 as `cpp/gateway/docs/CI.md` describes. Bun 1.4.0 may be installed when you need to run the TypeScript.


HARD WORKING RULE: your process can be restarted without warning and then knows only what is committed. Commit after every step of the plan (moves, each removal group, each rewrite); after a restart read `git log` and your report `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/cppgw-cleanup-removal-20261118.md` first.

DECISIONS ALREADY MADE (they override "OWNER DECISION" rows in the plan)
- `rust/`: remove entirely. `cloudflare.config.ts`, `wrangler.config.ts`, `tsconfig.cloudflare.json`, root `ops/` (legacy TypeScript launch and deploy operations) and `.github/workflows/deno-deploy.yml`: remove from this branch; they remain on the production and reference branches. Do not touch any deployed service, DNS or Cloudflare setting; this is a source-tree change only.
- `.gitleaksignore`: keep unchanged.
- The separate top-level C++ pilot (`cpp/CMakeLists.txt`, `cpp/CMakePresets.json`, `cpp/include/pilot`, `cpp/src`, `cpp/tests`, `cpp/tools` and its documents): remove it too if nothing under `cpp/gateway` builds from or tests against it (verify by grep and by the reduced build); otherwise keep it and say why.
- The legacy reference is the commit hash above. You cannot push tags; record the hash in `cpp/gateway/conformance/oracle-revision.txt` (as the plan says) and in the root `README.md`, and make every tool that needs the TypeScript oracle obtain it with `git fetch origin <hash>` plus `git worktree add --detach`. Tools that only existed to generate the port from TypeScript (`tools/manifest.py` regeneration, port-progress lists) may lose their regeneration mode; the checked-in data CMake consumes must keep working.
- Prefer deleting over rewriting. Where a C++ test reads a TypeScript source file only to compare text, move the needed bytes into a fixture under `cpp/gateway/tests/` rather than keeping the TypeScript file.

TASK
Execute the plan in its order: moves and path updates first (build still green), then the removals with `git rm -r`, then the root rewrites (the new root `README.md` introduces the repository as the native gateway and links `cpp/gateway/README.md`; `static_assets_test.cpp` asserts some README text: keep those assertions passing). Then prove the result on the cleaned tree, not a copy: `python3 cpp/gateway/tools/links.py --check`; one full release shard (`bash cpp/gateway/tools/ci-build.sh --config release --shard 1/4`) plus the runtime, static-file, stored-value (KV), permissions, startup and passkey tests in release; the portable package build and its verifier if Docker is available (`bash cpp/gateway/packaging/portable/build.sh ...`, `verify.sh`), since it builds the two native addons from the moved sources; the paired conformance suite once through the pinned-commit oracle; `actionlint` on the remaining workflows; `git grep` showing no remaining reference to a removed path from anything that is built, tested or packaged. The repository's hosted CI runs the full release, sanitizer and fuzz matrix when your branch is pushed, so do not spend time on all four shards yourself. No C++ test may be deleted or weakened; a test that cannot run without the TypeScript tree must get its inputs as fixtures or through the pinned oracle, and if neither is possible list it in the report instead of deleting it.

DONE WHEN
`git ls-files` contains no `.ts` application source outside what the plan keeps or moves, no `rust/`, and the checks above pass on the cleaned tree; the report gives tracked file and line counts before and after, the kept root entries with one-line reasons, every moved file (from, to), anything not removed and why, and anything unverified.
